newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar stays lower by close, tracks NY.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar stays lower by close, tracks NY.

text.p: LIFFE white sugar futures stayed lower by the close on Wednesday in tandem with weaker New York raws market.
Except for some light arbitrage and cross deals, activity was generally subdued.
"I think people are just taking the opportunity to sell London whites at these levels as they're expecting New York to drift down a touch," said one.
August close $1.60 down at $311.70 a tonne and October shed $1.70 to $303.30. Volume reached 1,793 lots, mainly in the two front months. The immediate support for August is seen at $310.00.
Traders said one leading commission house was a major seller in the afternoon, balanced by broker buying.
Aug/Oct spread ended at $8.40, slightly narrower than in recent days.
